description: This PHP file defines the 'FileManager' controller class within the OpenCart admin module. The class manages file browsing, uploading, folder creation, deletion, and listing functionalities for managing image files in the admin interface.

classes.name: FileManager
classes.description: Controller class handling file management operations such as listing, uploading, creating folders, and deleting files in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main file manager view with necessary data, including upload size limits, target identifiers, and thumbnails.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the file and directory list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view of directories and files within a specified directory, supporting pagination and filtering.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading of one or multiple image files to the specified directory, including validation and sanitation.

methods.name: folder
methods.description: Creates a new folder within the specified directory after validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected files or folders, after permission and existence checks.
